Title: Login fails with valid credentials
Description: Users cannot login with valid credentials, getting 'Invalid credentials' error
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to login page 2. Enter valid email: demo@example.com 3. Enter valid password: password123 4. Click Login button
Expected Behavior: User should be successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard
Actual Behavior: Error message 'Invalid credentials' appears, user remains on login page
Impact: High - blocks user access to application

Title: Dashboard calorie chart not displaying
Description: Calorie progress chart on dashboard shows empty state even when food entries exist
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login successfully 2. Add food entries for current day 3. Navigate to dashboard 4. View calorie section
Expected Behavior: Chart should display calorie consumption progress
Actual Behavior: Chart area is blank/empty with no data visualization
Workaround Available: Yes - can view data in text format

Title: Custom food creation form validation error
Description: Form shows validation error for required fields even when all fields are filled
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to Custom Foods 2. Click Add Custom Food 3. Fill all required fields: name='Test Food' calories='100' serving_unit='piece' category='Snack' 4. Submit form
Expected Behavior: Form should submit successfully and create custom food
Actual Behavior: Validation error appears: 'Please fill all required fields'

Title: Chatbot returns 'Authentication Error' for logged-in users
Description: Chatbot shows authentication error even when user is properly logged in
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login successfully 2. Navigate to Chatbot page 3. Enter query 'What should I eat for breakfast?' 4. Click Send
Actual Behavior: Error message: 'Authentication required. Please log in again.'

Title: USDA food search returns no results
Description: USDA food search returns 'No foods found' for common food items
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to USDA Food Search 2. Enter search term 'apple' 3. Click Search
Expected Behavior: Should return list of apple-related foods from USDA database
Actual Behavior: Message: 'No foods found for your search'
Workaround Available: Yes - can use custom foods instead

Title: Profile update fails with decimal weight values
Description: Cannot update profile when entering decimal weight values like 70.5
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Navigate to Profile page 2. Update weight to '70.5' 3. Click Save Changes
Expected Behavior: Profile should update successfully with decimal weight
Actual Behavior: Validation error: 'Weight must be a whole number'
Workaround Available: Yes - can round to whole numbers

Title: Food entry deletion confirmation dialog missing
Description: Deleting food entries doesn't show confirmation dialog, deletes immediately
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to Food Entries 2. Click delete button on any food entry
Expected Behavior: Should show confirmation dialog before deletion
Actual Behavior: Food entry is deleted immediately without confirmation

Title: Password reset email not received
Description: Password reset emails are not being sent to users
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Go to login page 2. Click 'Forgot Password' 3. Enter valid email address 4. Click Send Reset Link 5. Check email inbox
Expected Behavior: Should receive password reset email within few minutes
Actual Behavior: No email received after 30 minutes, checked spam folder

Title: Mobile responsive layout broken on food entries page
Description: Food entries page layout is broken on mobile devices, elements overlap
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Open application on mobile device 2. Login successfully 3. Navigate to Food Entries page
Expected Behavior: Page should be properly responsive with readable layout
Actual Behavior: Text overlaps, buttons are cut off, scrolling issues

Title: Session timeout not handled gracefully
Description: When session expires, users get generic error instead of login redirect
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login to application 2. Wait for session to expire (or manually expire) 3. Try to perform any action
Expected Behavior: Should redirect to login page with appropriate message
Actual Behavior: Generic error message appears, page becomes unresponsive

Title: API endpoint returns 500 error for dashboard data
Description: Dashboard API endpoint consistently returns 500 Internal Server Error
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login successfully 2. Navigate to dashboard 3. Check browser network tab
Evidence: Network logs: api-error-011.txt Server logs: server-error-011.log

Title: Duplicate food entries can be created
Description: System allows creation of identical food entries for same time
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Add food entry: Apple, 100 calories at 2:00 PM 2. Add same food entry again: Apple, 100 calories at 2:00 PM
Expected Behavior: Should either prevent duplicate or show warning
Actual Behavior: Both entries are created without any warning

Title: Calorie goal calculation incorrect for certain activity levels
Description: Daily calorie goal calculation appears incorrect for 'very active' users
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Set profile: age=25, weight=70kg, height=175cm, goal=maintain, activity=very_active 2. Check calculated daily calorie goal

Title: Chat history not loading in chatbot
Description: Previous chat conversations are not displayed when returning to chatbot
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Use chatbot to ask several questions 2. Navigate away from chatbot 3. Return to chatbot page
Actual Behavior: Chatbot shows only welcome message, no previous conversations

Title: Form fields retain values after logout
Description: Form fields retain user data after logout, potential security issue
Steps to Reproduce: 1. Login and fill various forms 2. Logout 3. Navigate back to forms without logging in
Expected Behavior: Forms should be cleared after logout
Actual Behavior: Previous user data still visible in form fields
